english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone makes a strong effort or pushes their abilities, such as trying hard to hear.
Use this when stressing that someone is making their maximum effort, rather than merely attempting something.

examples.english: I can't hear clearly, so I have to strain to hear.
examples.traditional: 我聽唔清楚，唯有盡力去聽。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 m4 cing1 co2 wai4 jau5 zeon6 lik6 heoi3 teng1

examples.english: The report is due tomorrow, so I’ll try my best to do it well.
examples.traditional: 份報告聽日要交，我會盡力做好。
examples.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 zou6 hou2
